newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KLTC buys 4,231 tonnes of frozen pork.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KLTC buys 4,231 tonnes of frozen pork.

text.p: Korea Livestock Trading Corp said on Tuesday it bought 4,231 tonnes of short-ribbed pork belly through a tender on January 15.
A KLTC official said it bought 800 tonnes from the Netherlands, 2,612 tonnes from Denmark, 108 from the United States, 100 tonnes from Ireland, 60 tonnes from Britain and 551 tonnes from Canada.
He said shipment was set for February 10 and February 20 to Seoul and Pusan.
The official said the original tender had been for 5,000 tonnes, and the unfilled portion had been included in the organisation's next tender.
Early Tuesday, KLTC invited a second tender for 5,769 tonnes of frozen pork on January 28.
It said it was a part of a government plan to buy 20,000 tonnes of pork to ease domestic prices.
